allow: PowerShell($pidOnPort = \(Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 8081 -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -First 1\).OwningProcess; if \($pidOnPort\) { Write-Output "Killing PID $pidOnPort"; Stop-Process -Id $pidOnPort -Force; Start-Sleep -Seconds 2; Write-Output "Killed." } else { Write-Output "Nothing on 8081." })
